WITH b AS (
 SELECT r.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date, p.subcategory AS sub, sl.quantity AS sold_qty, sl.sale_date, sl.net_amount, sl.channel_code
 FROM fact_return_line r
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')
SELECT reason_code, (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') AS in_p4_by_return_date, (hel_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30') AS in_p4_by_hel_ts,
 count(*) AS n, sum(quantity_returned) AS units, sum((sold_qty IS NULL)::INT) AS no_sale, sum((quantity_returned>sold_qty)::INT) AS over_return, sum((return_date<sale_date)::INT) AS before_sale, count(distinct sales_line_id) AS dist_sales
FROM b WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-09-05'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH r AS (
 SELECT r.sales_line_id, r.return_line_id, r.quantity_returned, r.return_date
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
 WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4),
agg AS (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) AS n, sum(quantity_returned) AS q FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) AS lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units, sum((a.n>1)::INT) AS lines_with_multiple_returns, sum((a.q>sl.quantity)::INT) AS over_returned, min(r.return_date)::VARCHAR AS mn, max(r.return_date)::VARCHAR AS mx
FROM r JOIN agg a USING (sales_line_id) JOIN fact_sales_line sl USING (sales_line_id)
